Should there be inclement weather on the lake, the day of your reservation, rescheduling your trip is decided by the owner of Riviera Marina at the time of the event. We will not reschedule or cancel due to a little bit of rain! This is an outdoor event and weather is dynamic! services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Dreaming of a fun-filled day on Lake Travis but missing a boat or jet ski? No worries! We’ve got you covered with an exciting array of watercraft rentals that promise an unforgettable adventure. Check out our options: Our affordable pricing and convenient marina store, stocked with everything from boat supplies to snacks and beer, make planning your day on the lake a breeze. Don’t stay inside when you can soak up the sun and explore Lake Travis! Please note, regardless of age, EACH child in your party will count towards the maximum occupancy on the boat. blurb: Riviera Marina offers boat rentals including ski boats, pontoon boats, and a double-decker Fun Ship with a captain. They also rent party barges for up to 50 people and have kayak and paddle board rentals in Cypress Creek cove. The marina provides dry stack boat storage and boat slips with various sizes.
